Joins 2025 code-violation counts per tract with CDC adult high-blood-pressure prevalence, computes the violation rate per 1,000 residents, keeps only non-null paired tracts, and returns the overall correlation with paired tract count ordered by the rate descending.
sql:
WITH code_counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS violation_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_274176' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
),
health AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid,
         CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
         CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence_pct
  FROM session.fw_274176_m2_cdc
),
paired AS (
  SELECT t.name,
         t.geoid,
         c.violation_count,
         h.totalpopulation,
         (c.violation_count / h.totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS violation_rate_per_1000_residents,
         h.adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence_pct
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  JOIN code_counts c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
  JOIN health h ON t.geoid = h.geoid
  WHERE c.violation_count IS NOT NULL AND h.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND h.adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence_pct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT name,
       violation_rate_per_1000_residents,
       violation_count,
       totalpopulation,
       adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence_pct,
       CORR(violation_rate_per_1000_residents, adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence_pct) OVER () AS correlation,
       COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
       geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY violation_rate_per_1000_residents DESC, name ASC
LIMIT 200
